_instructions: Enter actual tape measurements in millimetres (mm). Leave as null for unmeasured dimensions. Ensure the subject is in relaxed standing posture.

field_notes.stature: Floor to vertex (highest point of head). Subject stands erect, barefoot, heels together, looking straight ahead in Frankfort horizontal plane.
field_notes.head_circumference: Maximum circumference of the head passing immediately superior to the brow ridges (glabella) anteriorly and over the maximal occipital protuberance posteriorly.
field_notes.neck_base_circumference: Circumference at the base of the neck, crossing the cervicale posteriorly and resting in the supraclavicular fossa laterally.
field_notes.chest_circumference: Horizontal circumference of the torso at the level of the nipples / fourth costochondral junction during quiet mid-respiration, arms relaxed at sides.
field_notes.waist_circumference: Horizontal circumference of the torso at the level of noticeable waist narrowing (intermediate between lower rib margin and iliac crest) at end-expiration.
field_notes.hip_circumference: Maximum horizontal circumference around the buttocks / greater trochanters, standing with feet close together.
field_notes.crotch_height: Vertical distance from floor to the perineum / crotch fold, subject standing with feet slightly separated.
field_notes.ankle_circumference: Minimum circumference of the lower leg immediately superior to the medial and lateral malleoli.
field_notes.shoulder_elbow_length: Linear distance from acromion landmark (shoulder tip) to the olecranon process (elbow) with arm bent 90 degrees.
field_notes.shoulder_wrist_length: Linear distance from acromion landmark (shoulder tip) to the styloid process of the ulna / wrist crease with arm extended.
field_notes.inseam: Vertical distance along the medial side of the leg from crotch fold to floor / ankle.
field_notes.upper_arm_circumference_left: Circumference of left arm at midpoint between lateral tip of acromion and olecranon process, arm relaxed at side (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.upper_arm_circumference_right: Circumference of right arm at midpoint between acromion and olecranon, arm relaxed at side (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.forearm_circumference_left: Maximum circumference of left forearm, typically 3-5 cm distal to lateral epicondyle of humerus (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.forearm_circumference_right: Maximum circumference of right forearm (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.mid_thigh_circumference_left: Circumference of left thigh midway between inguinal crease and superior border of patella (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.mid_thigh_circumference_right: Circumference of right thigh midway between inguinal crease and superior border of patella (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.max_calf_circumference_left: Maximum circumference of left calf muscle belly, perpendicular to long axis of lower leg (rehab monitoring).
field_notes.max_calf_circumference_right: Maximum circumference of right calf muscle belly, perpendicular to long axis of lower leg (rehab monitoring).
